title: Playing drums with Earl Crumb's Owls Orchestra; Sieg Christensen
summary: Hirsch subbed for Earl Crum in the Owls, names the members, recalls Sieg Christensen and his father, and the Owls' string-band origins.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh I was going to ask you about the Earl Crumb, did you ever play in his band and if so what?

Yeah I played drums in the Owls Orchestra. Earl used to like to go sailing, he had a couple of girlfriends I think, I don't make it too public but he used to get lost on the weekend at the Yacht Club and they'd ring me up and say come on out and play and then I'd sit in with him and play for Take Earl's Place on the same weekends. I don't know, right now I can't remember the bass player, you know him. The tuba, yeah. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. He was at the Sangle with us. Dan played tuba. And there was Monk Smith and Benji White and Pinky. And there was a Monk Smith and Benji White and Pinky. And there was a Monk Smith and a Monk Smith. And there was a Monk Smith and a Monk Smith. Monk Smith and Benji White and Pinky and Rene Jalpe and Earl. And maybe a piano player? And well Sieg Christensen was with them when I was with them. Sieg Christensen was with them. Sieg's daddy and my daddy were very good friends, in fact they were both musicians, they worked together. In fact talking about, you're talking about Millenberg and the story got to me somehow that my father, he was a ladies man believe me, and he was fooling around with somebody and they were playing the job out in Millenberg and the last train was at 12 o'clock at night and I think my father missed the last train and he had to walk. Oh boy. He had to walk from Millenberg down to Decatur Street. It was a nice walk, he got in about 11 o'clock the next day. Of course he wasn't married in those days but that was a story I think that Sieg's father and mother told me. I remember Sieg's father, they used to have a dry goods store down there, I think on Spain Street down off of Burgundy. And Sieg and I we were raised together, I mean we were very close. He turned out to be a good pianist and he was with the Owls after Moe's Farrell. Moe's Farrell was the original piano player.
The original Owls were also string band players weren't they?
Yeah, they started off at that 6 and 7 eighths deal.
Did you ever hear him play in the string band mode? Never did. I never did hear him play.
